capabilityDecision.separationRule: Self and manager branches share routes but never union authority. When ownerPublicId equals the authenticated workerPublicId, only SELF may be evaluated. MANAGER requires ownerPublicId different from the authenticated workerPublicId plus a current assigned-manager population binding. If both branches appear valid, neither is complete, or branch selection is ambiguous, deny before effect; partial success across branches is forbidden.

predicateDecision.rule: Resolve tenant and actor only from trusted context. SELF requires ownerType WORKER and ownerPublicId equal the authenticated worker. MANAGER requires a current assigned-manager population binding for the exact owner and cycle. Bind Goal or proposed Goal owner, cycleVersionId, PERFORMANCE_GOAL or PERFORMANCE_ASSIGNED field decisions and PERFORMANCE_GOAL purpose before effect. Unknown, stale, mixed-tenant, caller-supplied population, missing field decision or missing purpose denies without existence disclosure.
